episodes.synopsis: The Matsuno brothers try to adapt their show to contemporary times, with mixed results.
episodes.title: Osomatsu-kun Returns

episodes.synopsis: The Matsuno brothers struggle to find employment. Later, Osomatsu tries to take an interest in his brothers' lives but winds up being a nuisance to them.
episodes.title: Let's Get a Job/The Melancholy of Osomatsu-kun

episodes.synopsis: A collection of unrelated shorts starring the wild and wacky cast of Osomatsu-san. A trip to outer space ends in disaster, the Pachinko Police are called in, and a familiar-looking puppet serial killer who can't seem to find the right sextuplet for his reverse-beartrap are among the skits featured.
episodes.title: Tidbits Collection

episodes.synopsis: The Matsuno brothers compete to ensure their divorcing parents will care of each of them. Meanwhile, Totoko asks the brothers for help in a crisis.
episodes.title: Let's Get Independent/This is Totoko

episodes.synopsis: Karamatsu gets kidnapped, but his brothers don't do anything. Later, a cat gets to speak and read minds, which causes mayhem for the Matsuno brothers.
episodes.title: The Karamatsu Incident/ESP Kitty

episodes.synopsis: The Matsunos are invited to Hatabou's birthday party. / Iyami discovers that his buckteeth contain a rare metal.
episodes.title: It's a Birthday Party, Dajo/Iyami's Great Discovery

episodes.synopsis: Todomatsu gets a job at a local coffeehouse. His brothers want no such success. / Dekapan and Dayon enjoy a carefree northbound trip together.
episodes.title: Todomatsu and the 5 Demons/To the North

episodes.synopsis: Captain Choromatsu invites an interesting detective onto an increasingly dangerous murder case to ease the tension of the crew. / Totoko wants to be a popular idol, but reality is so cruel.
episodes.title: The Calming Osomatsu/Totoko's Dream

episodes.synopsis: Karamatsu ends up as Chibita's apprentice at his oden stand. Meanwhile, Jyushimatsu falls in love and his brothers try to help him achieve his romance.
episodes.title: Chibita and Oden/Jyushimatsu Falls in Love

episodes.synopsis: Iyami and Chibita dress up as girls, and trick the Matsuno brothers into falling in love with them with the help of a sex-change drug. It's only a matter of time before this plan goes bad.
episodes.title: Iyami and Chibita's Rental Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: A series of Christmas-themed skits. Among those included are a zombified cold open, Ichimatsu disturbing a happy couple on a date, an F6 holiday fantasy, and the Annual Matsuno Family Christmas Gift Exchange.
episodes.title: Christmas Osomatsu-san

episodes.synopsis: Osomatsu and Totoko host an end of year special broadcast, looking back on previous episodes to determine which of the brothers is the biggest loser.
episodes.title: Year-End Special-san

episodes.synopsis: A salaryman named Sanematsu takes care of his six siblings, the Matsuno brothers play the roles of a friend group of working girls, and Choromatsu gets caught during a private moment.
episodes.title: Sanematsu-san/Girlymatsu-san/Accident?

episodes.synopsis: The sextuplets catch a resilient cold. Later, the brothers question Todomatsu about all the things he hasn't told them about his personal life. Afterwards, Choromatsu plays a paranoid vice-principal overly worried about plans for his school's cultural festival.
episodes.title: We Caught a Cold/Todomatsu's Line/Choromatsu-sensei

episodes.synopsis: Jyushimatsu goes to a job interview, proving to be a total nuisance for the interviewers. Later, the Girlymatsus return to go on a ladies' trip, causing trouble for each other as they arrive. After, Chibita falls in love with a fairy who manifested from a lonely flower.
episodes.title: Interview/Girlymatsu-san 2/The Life of Chibita's Flower

episodes.synopsis: Ichimatsu gets a job interview at a cat cafe, but when in Rome, he does as the locals do. Later, in an apocalyptic world, F6 battles against Iyami and Dekapan, who are robbing the dry-skinned citizens of all of their lotion. After, Ichimatsu is forced to pretend to be Karamatsu after Osomatsu catches him trying on his clothes.
episodes.title: Cat Cafe/Matsuno Max/The Ichimatsu Incident

episodes.synopsis: A series of Jyushimatsu-oriented skits, including the fifth-youngest defusing a bomb, having a late-night cup of noodles, selling baseball doujins at Comiket, and devolving the world into its written essentials.
episodes.title: Jyushimatsu Festival

episodes.synopsis: The Girlymatsus attend a wedding and try very badly to pretend to not be jealous. / Wanting to become the main protagonist of the franchise again, Iyami holds a bizarre kart race to determine who the real star of Osomatsu-san will be.
episodes.title: Girlymatsu-san 3 / Iyami's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: A series of skits take place, set during the Sengoku era. Back in the present, Choromatsu decides to quit being an idol-worshipper and pursue a job, with only his self-awareness standing in the way.
episodes.title: Period Drama Osomatsu-san/Choromatsu Rising

episodes.synopsis: Hatabou starts his own catering service, cooking with a delicious mystery meat. Later, Osomatsu, Karamatsu, and the rest play delinquent high school students competing to see who's the toughest. Afterwards, Iyami starts a comedy class hoping to earn a quick buck.
episodes.title: Tell Me, Hatabou/School Matsu/Iyami's School

episodes.synopsis: On a rainy evening, the brothers play a fierce game of mahjong. Later, the brothers suddenly find themselves joined by a seventh brother, Kamimatsu, born from the goodness that fell out of the brothers' hearts.
episodes.title: Mahjong/Godmatsu

episodes.synopsis: Todomatsu holds auditions to take one of his brothers with him to a mixer, struggling to find anyone worth taking. Meanwhile, Iyami meets a kung-fu master who believes him to possess a special technique.
episodes.title: The Star of Hope, Todomatsu/Final Sheeeh

episodes.synopsis: When the family heater runs out of kerosene, the brothers to force each other to get a refill. Meanwhile, Osomatsu, Karamatsu, and Choromatsu find themselves in an underground village populated by a tribe of Dayon people.
episodes.title: Kerosene/Dayon Tribe

episodes.synopsis: Totoko is jealous when those she knows find more success than her. Meanwhile, Choromatsu manages to land a job and moves out of the house, with the other brothers soon following suit, leaving just Osomatsu alone.
episodes.title: Totoko's Huge Panic/Letter

episodes.synopsis: The brothers quickly abandon their new lifestyles upon learning they have been invited to a baseball tournament for the finale.
episodes.title: Osomatsu-san, Such as It Was
